text: cpp-opt-audit 是一个面向 DSH 的 C++ 审查与编写 skill，通过 skills 注册表向会话提供指令和参考资料。它先要求确认目标工程实际使用的 C++ 标准，再按 RAII 与所有权、移动语义、异常安全、性能与内存、容器算法、并发、模板、标准边界及 ABI 等维度给出带检查点、理由、反例与正例、适用标准的报告。默认只读审查，用户明确同意后才修改代码；没有剖析或基准数据时不宣称优化收益。适合维护 C++ 项目、排查资源管理或性能问题的开发者，可通过自动匹配或 /cpp-opt-audit 调用；插件本身没有额外密钥配置。

cpp-opt-audit is a DSH skill for C++ review. It confirms the project standard, then reviews ownership, exceptions, performance, and concurrency with evidence and applicable standards. Reviews are read-only by default; edits require user agreement. Invoke it automatically or with /cpp-opt-audit.
我想让 C++ 代码审查先确认项目实际使用的语言标准，再给出兼容建议。
帮我检查 C++ 代码里的资源所有权、RAII 和异常安全问题。
C++ 性能优化没有基准数据时，怎么避免凭直觉改代码？
想审查 C++ 并发代码中的数据竞争、锁和虚假唤醒。
Review my C++ code for ownership, exception safety, and resource leaks.
Help me check whether a C++ optimization fits the project’s actual standard.
cpp-opt-audit 的功能「标准识别」：先检查构建配置和编译信息确定目标 C++ 标准；证据不足或冲突时暂停并询问，再按该标准提供建议。 可通过自动触发或显式调用 skill 使用，并输出带证据的审查建议。
cpp-opt-audit 的功能「资源所有权审查」：检查资源是否由明确的 RAII 对象管理、智能指针所有权是否清晰，以及提前返回和异常路径是否仍能释放资源。 可通过自动触发或显式调用 skill 使用，并输出带证据的审查建议。
cpp-opt-audit 的功能「并发审查」：检查共享状态的同步、锁的 RAII 使用、多锁顺序和条件变量谓词，帮助定位竞态与死锁相关问题。 可通过自动触发或显式调用 skill 使用，并输出带证据的审查建议。
DSH 能不能按我项目的 C++ 版本限制来审查代码？
想先只读检查 C++ 代码，等我确认后再修改。

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · 安装：用 dsh CLI 装到指定 profile：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization
```

`--profile` 填要装到的 profile（这里按 web 写，`tui` 同理）；`desktop` profile 由桌面应用独占管理，命令行 `dsh plugin` 会拒绝，请改用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`。`dsh plugin` 之后的参数会原样交给 pnpm，所以从本地目录安装时把包名换成目录的绝对路径即可：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库目录的绝对路径>
```

本包是 bundle 插件：安装时会写入该 profile 的包依赖，并选中本包的 `cordis.patch.yml`。**不要手动改 profile 的 `package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`，也不要在 profile 目录里跑 pnpm。**

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · 安装：备选方式：在 DSH 会话里让智能体用 `plugin_manager` 工具的 `install_bundle` 动作安装，`target` 同样传包名或目录的绝对路径。

安装后无需重启即可在会话目录里看到 `cpp-opt-audit`；如果替换了已安装的同名包，需要重启以加载新的模块。

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · 内容结构：```
assets/cpp-opt-audit/
├── SKILL.md                          # 入口：硬规则、入口选择、五阶段工作流（0–4）、九维判据速查表、高频检查点
└── references/
    ├── standard-detection.md         # 标准探测步骤、__cplusplus 校验、17/20/23 降级映射

九个维度（类型安全、ABI 与接口设计合为一个维度）对应十个维度文件，每条标注适用标准；两个横向参考不按维度切分，分别负责「从症状反查候选成因」和「把结论变成可验证的证据」；各文件末尾单列了尚未覆盖的主题，避免把「没查到」当成「没问题」。

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · 作为纯文件 skill 使用：不想装插件时，把 `assets/cpp-opt-audit/` 整个目录复制到 skill 扫描根即可，例如：

- 用户级：`~/.dsh/skills/cpp-opt-audit/`
- 项目级：`<工程根>/.dsh/skills/cpp-opt-audit/`

目录名即 skill 名，`SKILL.md` 的 frontmatter 会被自动解析。

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · 开发：本包是 Host-only bundle：零运行时依赖、无构建步骤，`index.js` 直接作为入口导出 `apply`/`inject`/`name`。

```bash
node --check index.js                                  # 语法检查
node -e "import('./index.js').then(m => console.log(m.name, m.inject))"
npm test                                                # 运行插件契约测试
```

`npm test` 会走 `node --test` 并启动子进程；在限制子进程的环境（例如部分沙箱）里，改为逐个运行 `node test/provider.test.mjs`、`node test/package-manifest.test.mjs`。

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · 开发：插件在 `apply(ctx)` 里用 `ctx.skills.registerProvider(...)` 注册一个提供方，`list()` 解析 `SKILL.md` 的 frontmatter 生成目录条目，`get()` 每次重新读取正文（因此编辑 skill 内容无需重新安装）。

改 frontmatter 时注意格式：`name` 必须是单行 `name: cpp-opt-audit`，`description` 支持单行、`description: >`（折叠为一段）与 `description: |`（保留换行）三种写法。写成其他形式（例如 `description` 后直接换行却不给 `>` / `|`）会让插件在加载期直接报错，并提示可用写法。

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · 发布：```bash
npm publish --access public
```

发布前核对 `package.json` 中的 `repository`/`homepage`/`bugs` 与 `files` 清单，并用 `npm pack --dry-run` 确认包内文件与版本号。

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · @chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization：English | [中文](README.md)

A bundle plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) that ships one skill, **`cpp-opt-audit`**, for auditing or writing fast *and* safe low-level C++.

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · @chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization：Its central constraint is that the **target project's actual C++ standard is detected first**: when detection fails the skill asks the user, and until the standard is confirmed it never recommends or writes a feature newer than that standard. Every finding carries a checkpoint, a reason, a bad→good code pair, and the minimum standard.

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · Install：Install it into a profile with the dsh CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization
```

`--profile` picks the profile to install into (web here; `tui` works the same), while `desktop` is managed exclusively by the desktop app — the CLI rejects it, so use `plugin_manager`'s `install_bundle` instead. Everything after `dsh plugin` is passed straight to pnpm — so to install from a local checkout, pass the directory's absolute path instead of the package name:

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add <absolute path of this repository>
```

This is a bundle plugin: installation writes the profile's package dependency and selects this package's `cordis.patch.yml`. Do not edit the profile's `package.json` or `cordis.patch.yml` by hand, and do not run pnpm inside the profile directory.

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · Install：Alternative: ask the agent in a DSH session to install it with the `plugin_manager` tool's `install_bundle` action, passing the package name or the directory's absolute path as `target`.

The skill appears in the session catalog without a restart; replacing an already installed copy of the package requires a restart to load the new module.

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · Layout：```
assets/cpp-opt-audit/
├── SKILL.md                          # rules, entry routing, five-phase workflow (stages 0–4), nine-dimension quick table, top checkpoints
└── references/
    ├── standard-detection.md         # standard detection, __cplusplus checks, C++17/20/23 downgrades

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · Layout：Checkpoints are grouped into nine dimensions (type safety, ABI and interface design form one dimension), which map to ten checkpoint files; each names its minimum standard. Two cross-cutting references are not split by dimension: one goes from symptoms to candidate causes, the other turns conclusions into verifiable evidence. Every file lists the topics that are not covered yet.

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · Use as a plain filesystem skill：Without installing the plugin, copy `assets/cpp-opt-audit/` into any scanned skill root, for example `~/.dsh/skills/cpp-opt-audit/` or `<project>/.dsh/skills/cpp-opt-audit/`. The directory name is the skill name.

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · Development：Host-only bundle: no runtime dependencies and no build step. `index.js` exports `apply`, `inject`, and `name` directly.

```bash
node --check index.js
node -e "import('./index.js').then(m => console.log(m.name, m.inject))"
npm test
```

`npm test` runs `node --test`, which spawns child processes; where child processes are restricted (for example inside some sandboxes), run `node test/provider.test.mjs` and `node test/package-manifest.test.mjs` individually.

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · Development：`apply(ctx)` registers a provider through `ctx.skills.registerProvider(...)`. `list()` parses the `SKILL.md` frontmatter into a catalog entry, and `get()` re-reads the body on every load, so editing skill content needs no reinstall.

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · Development：Keep the frontmatter in a supported shape: `name` stays on one line as `name: cpp-opt-audit`, and `description` accepts a single line, a `description: >` folded block, or a `description: |` literal block. Any other form makes the plugin fail at load time with a message listing the accepted shapes.

@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization README · Publish：```bash
npm publish --access public
```

Before publishing, check `repository`/`homepage`/`bugs` and the `files` list in `package.json`, and confirm the tarball contents and version with `npm pack --dry-run`.
